d:
A small bipedal Pokémon with an evolved steel-type form. The head remains a small, rounded shape with a deep crimson colored face and two pointed ears. Two massive, ornate jet black steel jaws emerge from the back of the head, now featuring larger, more menacing pale yellow eyes. It has short, stubby legs and two small paws with three claws each. No tail.
BODY COLOR: deep crimson
